item.title: Helldivers 2 devs slash install size from 154GB to 23GB
item.description:

item.title: GSWT: Gaussian Splatting Wang Tiles
item.description:
📝 GSWT: Gaussian Splatting Wang Tiles SIGGRAPH Asia 2025, Hong Kong Yunfan Zeng1, Li Ma2, Pedro V. This enables stochastic yet continuous tiling of Gaussian fields over arbitrary surfaces, allowing for procedural generation of expansive terrains with high spatial diversity. Furthermore, we introduce several rendering optimizations tailored to the unique characteristics of 3DGS Wang tiles, achieving real-time rendering of large-scale 3DGS terrains.
🔗 Read more: https://yunfan.zone/gswt_webpage/

item.title: Microsoft lowers AI software sales quota
item.description:
